name: print-social-digital-marketing-agency-poster-blue-black-crossed-ribbon-headline
title: 'Digital Marketing Agency' poster with a blue-tinted portrait and a crossed black ribbon headline
whatItIs: A poster with a blue-tinted photo of a person using a phone and a play-button icon, a blue 'Digital Marketing Agency' bar, two crossed black ribbon bands both reading 'Creative Solutions' in different sizes, body copy, and a grey footer with service pills and contact icons.
whatItMeans: Bold and slightly chaotic on purpose; crossing two ribbons of the same message creates emphasis through visual noise.
techniques: Cross two ribbon bands at an angle for graphic tension.
Repeat one key phrase twice at different scales for emphasis.
Tint a photo in the brand's primary colour.

vocabulary.definition: Two angled bands overlapping in an X shape.
Repeating a phrase to reinforce its importance.
